medical_notice: This list only helps coordination. It is not medical advice. Eligibility and blood compatibility are decided by qualified health or transfusion services.
error_load: Could not load data. Check your connection and try again.
no_results_hint: Try a different blood group or area.
setup_intro: Create the first administrator for your organization. Do this immediately after deploying, before sharing the site address. This page stops working once setup is complete.
setup_closed: Setup could not be completed because it was already done.
setup_failed: Setup failed. Check the email and password and try again.
setup_config_hint: Check that public/js/site-config.js contains your Firebase project settings and that Firestore rules are deployed.
login_failed: Sign-in failed. Check your email and password.
no_access_body: This account is not an active administrator.
export_warn: This file will contain personal information (names and phone numbers). Store it securely. Fields included:
display_name_hint: Shown publicly if consent is given. Use an alias or first name, not the full name.
last_donation_hint: Leave empty if unknown; the status will show “verification needed”.
consent_text: Public listing shows only: display name, blood group, district, availability status and last update. Phone number, address and notes are never shown. The donor can withdraw consent at any time.
consent_label: The donor agrees to appear in the public directory
private_notes_hint: Do not record medical or health details.
save_failed: Could not save. Please try again.
no_forced_donation: Emergency help must never be made conditional on giving blood in return.
lang_invalid: Enable at least one language, including the default one.
interval_hint: Operational setting only. It does not decide medical eligibility.
policy_hint: Review with your own legal obligations before publishing.
contact_hint: How people can reach your coordinators.
request_list_privacy: Phone numbers and patient details are never shown here.
status_hint: Only Available, Recovery and Unavailable donors (with consent) appear publicly. Pending, Hidden and Needs-review donors never do.
archive_confirm: Archive this donor? They disappear from the public list; donation history is kept.
archive_hint: Archiving is the default way to remove someone: history and audit trail stay intact.
delete_type_confirm: This cannot be undone. Type the donor's full name to confirm: {name}
delete_hint: Permanent delete removes the donor record. Donation history documents stay (they are never hard-deleted). Check your retention policy and backups first.
reverse_reason: Reason for reversing this donation record:
recipient_ref_hint: Short reference only (e.g. hospital name). Never shown publicly.
dup_donor: Possible duplicate: an existing donor has this phone number
dup_application: Possible duplicate: another pending application has this phone number
reject_confirm: Reject this item? The reason stays in the internal note only.
verify_date: I verified this donation date (otherwise it stays unverified)
verify_by_phone: Verify identity, number and consent by phone, Messenger or WhatsApp before approving. Approving does not certify medical eligibility.
no_match: No matching donor — choose manually or reject
multi_match: More than one donor shares this phone number. Check carefully.
report_review_hint: Confirm the donation date and the donor before approving. Next eligible date is recalculated on approval.
hospital_hint: Optional. Kept private; never shown publicly.
show_public: Show a privacy-safe summary on the public list
phone_invalid: Enter a valid phone number (digits, +, spaces, 6–20 characters).
hide_confirm: Remove this request from the public list? The private record stays.
icon_hint: Optional https:// image used as the browser tab icon. If empty, the built-in blood-drop icon is used.
contact_settings_hint: Shown on confirmation screens and in the “Get blood” panel. Donors' own numbers are never shown.
whatsapp_hint: Use a link you have tested, e.g. https://wa.me/8801XXXXXXXXX (country code, no +).
pledge_hint: Optional. Leave empty for the default wording. The pledge is voluntary and never a condition for help.
add_admin_hint: Creates a login for another administrator. Share the password through a safe channel, never in public chats.
email_in_use: This email already has an account.
recovery_hint: No “forgot password” option exists. If an admin loses access, another admin can add a new admin account, or the project owner can reset the password in the Firebase console.
contact_not_set: The coordinator's contact details have not been set yet.
message_hint: Send this message to the coordinator (it is pre-filled on WhatsApp).
wa_msg_donor: I would like to coordinate blood with {name}. Please contact me and help arrange it.
contact_panel_intro: Donors are not called directly. Contact our coordinator to arrange blood with {name}.
wait_seconds: Please wait {n} seconds before submitting again.
submit_failed: Could not submit. Check your connection and try again.
keep_reference: Keep this ID. Mention it when you contact the coordinator.
wa_msg_ref: My reference ID is {ref}. Please confirm.
last_donation_unverified: Optional. An administrator will verify this date.
public_consent_text: If you agree, the public list shows only: display name, blood group, district, availability and last update. Your phone number, address and notes are never shown.
public_consent_label: I agree to appear in the public donor list
privacy_consent_label: I understand my details are stored privately and used only for blood-donation coordination
donor_done_body: Your application is pending verification. You are not on the public list yet. A coordinator may call you to verify your details.
donor_intro: No OTP is used. A coordinator verifies applications manually.
pledge_default: I voluntarily pledge to enrich our blood bank by donating one bag of blood when I am able and healthy.
note_hint: Do not write the patient's full name or medical details.
pledge_optional: Optional. Your request for help does not depend on it.
request_privacy_label: I agree that my contact details are shared only with coordinators, and a privacy-safe summary may be shown publicly
request_done_body: Your request is pending coordinator confirmation and a summary (without phone numbers) now appears on the public request list.
request_intro: You can request blood without being a donor. A coordinator will contact you.
report_phone_hint: Used by an administrator to match you with your donor record.
report_done_body: Thank you. An administrator will verify it. Your next possible date updates after approval.
report_intro: Tell us about a blood donation you made. It counts only after an administrator approves it.
deactivate_confirm: Deactivate this admin? They lose access.
